task.title: P6-188 review leftovers: teardown from==to guard, delete TOCTOU scope, board-path CI coverage
task.description: Filed from the P6-188 adversarial review (2026-08-09). Three real-but-not-blocking items: (1) teardown has no to_collection_id != collection_id guard, so it can write a from==to ledger row — the only source of the self-move rows the delete planner now defends against; add the guard. (2) delete_collection's FOR UPDATE covers only the subject collection row; a concurrent add_holding into the collection between snapshot and the deleted_at stamp is silently hidden (and a concurrently-hidden child can appear in the receipt's reparented list without having been re-parented) — alpha-tolerable single-user race; consider locking holdings or re-checking counts before commit. (3) the delete planner's apply() model ignores boards, so the destination-side Board::Main collapse in the executor is exercised only by the #[ignore]d delete_live dev test, never in CI — extend the planner model or add a board-aware no-DB test. Also note: the wire change (POST body now required) 422s a stale rolling APK posting the old empty body — self-heals on next APK install, alpha-acceptable. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md.
